sources: recreation.gov search API record for poi 241802 'Lake Como Campground' (not reservable), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Every site has electric and water hookups; the amperage is not published.

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/lake-como-campground ('all sites feature electrical and water hookups', 'Each site has water hookups, with additional faucets located through the campground', '$25 per night per campsite (water/electricity included)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 8 single and 2 double sites (the Forest Service page also says '12 total sites', presumably counting each double twice), all 125-ft pull-through spurs, plus a host site. Three accessible. No maximum rig length is published.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/lake-como-campground ('a single loop with 125' pull through sites for recreational vehicle RVs with spurs that include 8 single sites and 2 double sites. (12 total sites)') + recreation.gov poi 241802 description ('a host site and ten 125' pull through recreational vehicle (RV) sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Garbage service. Food storage order (bear country).

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/lake-como-campground ('4 accessible vault toilets', 'Potable water is available at this site', 'Water and garbage services are also provided', 'Food Storage Required'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Peak Season: Memorial Day - Labor Day. Non-Peak Season: Weather Dependent.' The page carried a 'Site Closed' banner on 2026-10-22.
Water and electricity included; the fee includes one recreation-area day-use pass (otherwise $5/vehicle/day or $30/season, Memorial Day-Labor Day). Extra vehicles need a pass.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/lake-como-campground ('Single Site (Electric + Water): $25 per night', '$25 per night per campsite (water/electricity included). Fee includes 1 pass for day use within the recreation area'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/lake-como-campground ('Senior, Annual, and Access Passes are honored at all Lake Como fee sites.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service (Darby Ranger District). 'First come/first serve, no reservations.' Limit 2 vehicles per site (truck + trailer counts as one).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/lake-como-campground ('First come/first serve, no reservations. Camping is limited to 7 days and is $25 per night.', 'Parking is limited to 2 vehicles per site'), read 2026-10-22

note: Bitterroot NF, Lake Como Recreation Area between Darby and Hamilton. 'Lower Como': a paved loop under mixed pine and fir just below the Lake Como dam; the swim beach, loop trail and motorized boat launch are in the recreation area. --Claude
summary: Confirmed FCFS/no reservations, 7-day limit, water hookups (electric too, amperage unpublished), 10 pull-through sites, vault toilets and potable water. Added $25/night fee (2026 page), senior/access pass honored, season (peak Memorial Day-Labor Day). Cleared derived max_rig_ft 40 (no page states it; sites are 125-ft pull-through spurs). Note trimmed.
